entries.speaker: David Hilbert
entries.quote: Aus dem Paradies, das Cantor uns geschaffen, soll uns niemand vertreiben können.
entries.work: quoted in Martin Meyries, “Was ist Unendlichkeit – und wenn ja, wie viele?”, arXiv:1310.4739 [math.HO] (17 Oct 2013), where it is given as from Hilbert (1926), i.e. “Über das Unendliche,” Mathematische Annalen 95 (1926), pp. 161–190, lecture delivered 4 June 1925, Münster

entries.speaker: David Hilbert
entries.quote: No one shall drive us out of the paradise which Cantor has created for us.
entries.work: “On the infinite” (“Über das Unendliche,” Mathematische Annalen 95 (1926), pp. 161–190), lecture delivered 4 June 1925 to the Westphalian Mathematical Society, Münster; trans. Erna Putnam and Gerald J. Massey, in Paul Benacerraf and Hilary Putnam (eds.), Philosophy of Mathematics: Selected Readings (Cambridge University Press), pp. 183–201
